product.description_body: The flubberhomme is a portable bottle-style blender (model LL-890). It recharges over USB with the included cable and packs 4 stainless steel cross blades to blend fruit, ice or shakes and sip straight from the cup.
product.feature_3: Transparent bottle-style cup with screw cap
product.faq_1_q: Can it handle ice and frozen fruit?
product.faq_1_a: Yes. The 4 steel blades blend ice and frozen fruit; cut it into pieces and don't go past the max fill line.
product.faq_2_q: How long does the battery last?
product.faq_2_a: A full charge gives you several blends in a row. It recharges over USB with the included cable.
product.faq_3_a: The cup rinses easily. Add water with a drop of soap, run it a few seconds and you're done. Don't submerge the motor base.
product.faq_4_a: The blender (model LL-890), the USB charging cable and the user manual.
